page.overview:
Who is Captain Pikell?

Captain Pikell is a supporting character in Invincible, debuting from Season 4 and onwards.

He is a mid-ranking member of the Coalition of Planets.

Pikell has a humanoid alien with a lean built, purple skin with no visible body or facial hair except his eyebrows and has black irises. His head is long with the top of his head having a conical shape.

Pikell wears a standard Coalitions Officer Uniform similar to Telia. He wears a full-sleeve, collared up shirt with a black and red colour design and an Emblem to signify his status as the Captain of the crew. He also wears black pants with a silver metallic belt and black shoes.
